messages:
cam: Quick heads-up — I'm planning to spin up release/1.16-stable in ~2h. Need owners for post-cut smoke and a changelog sweep.
li: what's the cutoff time for merges into main?
cam: soft cutoff is 2024-11-15 18:00 UTC. After that only critical hotfixes with release owner sign-off.
olivia: I can own the changelog sweep and assemble concise PR bullets. Will do a first pass by EOD.
devops-jen: For automation, make sure the branch name matches `release/*` and PRs include the `release:1.16` label so CI and staging picks them up. Also double-check canary jobs are enabled.
cam: plan for branch creation (will run this from main):
```bash
git checkout -b release/1.16-stable origin/main
git push origin release/1.16-stable
```
max: do we need a version bump in the repo before creating the branch? I remember some infra expects an explicit version file change.
olivia: good catch — please open a small PR that bumps the version to `1.16.0-rc.1` and reference the changelog PR so the docs team can link it.
cam: @max can you take the bump? if not i will. need it merged before we lock main.
max: on it, will open the bump PR in ~30m. :thumbsup:
release-bot: I created branch release/1.16-stable at commit abc1234 — CI queued and status checks started. :sparkles:
cam: thanks! @olivia once you have the changelog draft please paste the link here and we'll schedule the docs merge. Also a quick reminder on backports: only bugfixes approved by a release owner get cherry-picked.
li: noted. I'll gate backports with the `backport-eligible` label + explicit owner approval in the PR description.
olivia: sending PR list and short summaries into #eng-releases later today so reviewers can triage.
cam: perfect. If anyone needs to opt out of canary or has critical infra concerns, call it out now; otherwise we'll proceed with the canary rollout after CI green.
max: no opt-outs from my side, proceeding with bump+PR.
cam: ok — closing this thread after we see the bump PR and the changelog link. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
